title: incident-bot: add /backup-status and /restore-checklist shortcuts for Private DR
author: Sergio Costa
body:
Context
Private DR game days and support escalations keep re-discovering the same issue: during an incident we spend 5–10 minutes just hunting for the right runbook and dashboard (and we often paste stale links). This PR adds two low-friction incident-bot shortcuts so oncall can get to the canonical Private backup/restore docs and observability views in one command.

What’s included
- New slash command: /backup-status
  - Posts a short “quicklinks” message for Private backup troubleshooting:
    - Confluence: Backup create + verify runbook
    - Confluence: SRE backup failure troubleshooting
    - Dashboard: Private Backup/Restore overview (success rate, last-success age, duration percentiles)
    - Alert panel: Missed backup window / repeated failure alerts
  - Optional args:
    - /backup-status <cluster>
    - /backup-status --env prod|staging
  - If a cluster is provided, we include a pre-filled dashboard link with cluster label applied (Grafana var=cluster).

- New slash command: /restore-checklist
  - Posts a “restore drill checklist” message intended for incident channels:
    - Link: In-place restore runbook
    - Link: Restore-to-new-cluster runbook
    - Link: DR restore drill template (timeline/evidence)
    - Reminder bullets (maintenance mode, validation gates, who to page)

- Link hygiene + single source of truth
  - All URLs are centralized in a small config map (so we don’t hardcode Confluence IDs across handlers).
  - Confluence base URL and Grafana base URL are already configurable; this PR reuses the existing env var pattern.

Usage examples
- /backup-status
- /backup-status rw-private-northbridge-prod
- /backup-status rw-private-helix-prod --env prod
- /restore-checklist

Notes on behavior
- Commands are intentionally “dumb” (no API calls to Grafana/Prometheus). During incidents we primarily need the right links and a consistent checklist; any data lookups would add permissions + failure modes.
- Responses are ephemeral by default in non-incident channels; in #inc-* channels we post publicly so the whole room has the links. (Matches existing incident-bot behavior for /runbook.)

Testing
- Added unit tests for parsing and output formatting.
- Added snapshot-ish tests to ensure links remain stable and we don’t regress formatting.

Screenshots
- Included in review as Slack message previews (see below).

Rollout
- No breaking changes. Commands are additive.
- After merge, we should update the internal oncall cheat sheet to reference these shortcuts (tracked in ENG-4920).

Review discussion highlights
- Rafael: requested that restore checklist include both in-place and new-cluster runbooks + the drill template. Implemented.
- Allison: requested that dashboard links be parametrized by cluster label and environment; also asked to keep all URLs in one config module. Implemented.
- Elliot: requested copy edits to make the operator language consistent with Docs naming (“Private backup/restore”) and to avoid “PITR” jargon in bot output. Implemented.

Related
- ENG-4821 Day-2 Ops Toolkit: Backup/Restore (Private)
- ENG-4869 Observability requirements (dashboards/alerts/runbook link conventions)

Release notes
- incident-bot: added /backup-status and /restore-checklist shortcuts for Private DR quicklinks and restore drill checklist.
commits: Add /backup-status command handler and argument parsing
Add /restore-checklist command handler with canonical runbook links
Centralize Private DR links in config + env overrides
Tests: command parsing + message formatting snapshots
Docs: update incident-bot README with new commands
